shared_elements: arms/limbs rendered in low relief against the body of a monolithic block
justification: A depicts a single three-dimensional human-like bust with an emphatic head, deep eye sockets and hands folded on the torso, while B shows a flat pillar face bearing low-relief profile animals (a quadruped/reptile and other creatures) plus a serpentine or netted motif on an upper beam; the only overlap is the broad idea of a monolithic stone bearing a figural image with relief limbs. There is no shared specific motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the modes differ fundamentally — sculpture in the round of a frontal human head versus flat profile animal reliefs arranged in registers.
